prompt: Set up a dead-letter queue in NATS JetStream: when a message in my work queue fails processing 5 times, it should go to a DLQ so I can inspect and replay it. Go.

assertions.text: States NATS has no native dead-letter queue
Consumes the MAX_DELIVERIES advisory to catch exhausted messages
Republishes/copies the failed message to a separate DLQ stream
Notes the original message is not auto-deleted from the stream
